steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation screen.
Make savings configuration mandatory for publishing.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation.
Configure the project with an RFQ-only stage.
Work on the RFQ stage before selecting its template.
Apply the first available RFQ template; the case does not provide a specific template name.
Add the requested CYLINDER line item with quantity 10.
Populate the RFQ pricing sheet so the event is complete apart from savings configuration.
Set the requested delivery location on the line item.
Add the vendor named in the case as a participant.
Attempt publish and assert Procol refuses it because savings configuration was omitted.
